hints.title: Bilateral Height Accumulation
hints.text: To support n up to 10^5, precalculate the maximum height sum of non-decreasing prefixes and non-increasing suffixes.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Prefix DP
hints.text: Use a monotonic stack of increasing indices. When a new element is smaller, it replaces a block of previous elements with its value.

hints.title: Combining Left and Right
hints.text: Combine left[i] and right[i] at each candidate peak i, subtracting maxHeights[i] to avoid double counting.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumSumOfHeights(self, maxHeights: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(maxHeights)
        left = [0] * n
        stack = [-1]
        curr = 0
        for i, h in enumerate(maxHeights):
            while len(stack) > 1 and maxHeights[stack[-1]] > h:
                idx = stack.pop()
                curr -= maxHeights[idx] * (idx - stack[-1])
            curr += h * (i - stack[-1])
            stack.append(i)
            left[i] = curr
        right = [0] * n
        stack = [n]
        curr = 0
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            h = maxHeights[i]
            while len(stack) > 1 and maxHeights[stack[-1]] > h:
                idx = stack.pop()
                curr -= maxHeights[idx] * (stack[-1] - idx)
            curr += h * (stack[-1] - i)
            stack.append(i)
            right[i] = curr
        return max(left[i] + right[i] - maxHeights[i] for i in range(n))
```

complexity.notes: Two monotonic stack passes computing prefix and suffix contributions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) peak iteration times out for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for left and right sum arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use monotonic stack to achieve linear time mountain sum optimization.
